profile.headline: Software Engineer at Intel
profile.summary:
-Software engineer with direct experience in premier software organizations spanning the whole software cycle, from development through support.

-Experience in large corporations, start-ups and as an independent consultant.

-Expert in storage technology with direct experience in firmware development, device drivers, kernel infrastructure, volume managers and filesystems in many platforms.

-Excellent "people" skills, strong communications abilities and proven leadership.

Specialties: Storage, support, firmware development, kernel development, device drivers, RAID, SAN, SCSI, filesystem, volume managers.

Support of critical accounts, 24 x 7 support models, troubleshooting. 

Software development, software engineering, software development process.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer developing embedded systems for telecommunications equipment. Responsibilities included:
- Developing firmware for Ethernet Switching Equipment, including g.8032 rings, runmode controls software, LAGs and MPLS.
- Developed the gRPC management implementation for the Waveserver 2 product line.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer working on the AT&T partnership. Responsibilities included:
- Specifying  and provisioning systems for Web services
- Developer of front end and back end software in PHP and Javascript.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Support Expert
positions.description: Part of the 3rd level support team with responsibilities for the most critical customers using HP-UX. This coverage is done by a geographically dispersed team as a 24 x 7 operation.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Consultant
positions.description:
Responsible for sales, team management and implementation of projects including:

-Development of a GUI for Unixware System adminstration.
-Development of advanced I/O futures including multipath I/O for Unixware.
-Development of fault tolerant device drivers for telco grade equipment from Sun. Became the Sun recommended provider for this process. Hardened drivers for SS7 solutions from ADC/Newnet, Lucent and SBE.
-Ported a large business application owned by AT&T from HP-UX to Solaris.
-Part of the team developing the IA-64 HP-UX kernel.

positions.description: I/O team member for the Unixware kernel

positions.description: I/O team member for the Unixware Kernel.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Startup. 

Responsible for design and implementation of RAID firmware, and device drivers for host systems mostly Unix.

Founding member of the R&D department.
